verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Masanil ex stakji he ti', kotanhek, ul uq'ek ha ha'. Ha ex malaj he tumin, kotanhek ul chaek tas tze wa t'a nab'anhej, ul chaek yal uwa yet' lech manh tupb'ilok.

¿Tas yuj tze komon lajej he tumin t'a tas manh waelok? ¿Tas yuj tze komon lajej he tojol tze cha t'a tas to max b'ut'ji he k'ol yuj? Ab'ek wal sik'lab'il tas ol wala': Tato tze k'anab'ajej tas swala', ol he wa wael te wach', ol ex b'ut'jok wal sik'lab'il.
Kotanhek t'ayin, maklejek wal eyab' tas swala', ol ex ajnhejek'ok. Ol in b'o junok in trato eyet'ok t'a junelnhej yujto tzex in xajanej, yik tz'elk'och in ti' wak'nak t'a winhaj rey David.
Ha in wak'nakoch winhaj David chi' testigoal t'a juntzanhxo nakión, yik skuchb'an winh, ma yik syak'an yajalil winh t'ay.
Ol eyawtejkot heb' anima manh eyojtakok. Ha heb' anima chi' elanhchamel ol ja lemnaj heb' t'ayex, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, Ha inxonhej Ochi, a in ol ex wak' ik'jokchaanh, xchi Jehová.
Hak'uekoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yakb'an tzato yal eyawaj t'ay. Awajanhek t'ay, yakb'an lak'anto ayeq'ui.
Ha ex chuk he b'eyb'al yet' ex chuk he pensar, aktejekkan juntzanh he chukal chi'. Meltzajanhek t'a Jehová. Ol ok'xok sk'ol t'ayex, ol ex yak' niwank'olal ko Diosal.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha tas nab'il wuuj, manh lajanok yet' tas tze na'a. Ha tas tzin k'ulej, manh lajanok yet' tas tze k'ulej.
Ha in pensar yet' tas tzin k'ulej chi' manh lajanok icha eyiko', yujto yel wal te ek'b'alxo tas tzin na' chi' t'a yichanh schaanhil yajk'e satcha'anh t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.

Ha yaxnhab' yet' k'een sakb'akom tz'emta t'a satcha'anh, max meltzajlaj t'a ichnhej ta', palta to sch'ayxikan lum lum yuj yik wach' sk'eul masanil tas tz'awchaj t'a lu'um. Syak'an sat, tz'elta yinhatil yik syal yawchajxi, syak'anpax swael heb' anima.
Icha yaxnhab' chi', icha chi' yaj in lolonel, max meltzajlaj t'ayin t'a ichnhej ta', palta to sb'okan tas nab'il wuuj, tz'elpaxk'och tas tzin nib'ej.

Tzalajk'olal ol aj eyelta b'aj ayex ek' presoal, junk'olal ol aj he meltzaj t'a he chonhab'. Masanil lum witz, lum tzalkixtak, ichato ol k'e wal sjaj lum t'a chaanh yuj tzalajk'olal. Ha te' niwak te', icha wal to ol stz'it sk'ab' te' stzalaji.

Ha lum b'aj ay te' q'uiix, a te' k'ub'taj ol q'uib'ok. Ha lum b'aj ay te' sak q'uiix, a te' arrayán ol q'uib' sk'exulok te'. Ol in k'ulej juntzanh tik yik sb'inaj in b'i a in Jehová in tik, yik tzin nachajnhejkot t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
